now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#14
now.text: Antoine Triplett and Jemma Simmons become close friends, with a flirtation between them.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A close friend Trip flirts with.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A close friend Jemma flirts with.

proposed.text: Antoine Triplett comes aboard the Bus with John Garrett and stays behind with Jemma Simmons, helping her treat the dying Skye and showing an attraction to her.

changes.evidence: In T.A.H.I.T.I. (S1#14) Trip first meets Simmons: he stays on the Bus with her in case his medical training is needed, helps her treat Skye's seizure, and shows an attraction to her. Their close friendship builds over later episodes (Hub in S1#16 onward, to his death in S2#10), so 'become close friends' sums up later episodes in the first-meeting stage.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#16
now.text: Felix Blake works with Victoria Hand during the hunt for the Clairvoyant and shares his suspicion that Coulson's team may be double agents. After Deathlok cripples Blake, Hand blames Coulson's plan.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Agent Blake hunts the Clairvoyant with, sharing his doubts about Coulson.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Agent Hand hunts the Clairvoyant with, who suspects Coulson's team.

proposed.text: Felix Blake and Victoria Hand join Coulson aboard the Bus to plan the hunt for the Clairvoyant. After Deathlok nearly kills Blake, Hand tells Coulson his plan was flawed from the start.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Agent Blake hunts the Clairvoyant with. Blames Coulson's plan when Blake is hurt.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Agent Hand hunts the Clairvoyant with, until Deathlok nearly kills him.

changes.evidence: In End of the Beginning (S1#16) Blake and Hand are briefed together on the Bus; after Deathlok caves in Blake's chest, Hand tells Coulson the plan was flawed from the start. Blake's report to Hand that Coulson's team may be double agents is not shown in S1#16: the wiki sources it to Turn, Turn, Turn (S1#17), so the text and both card lines carry a later title's reveal.

owner_calls.question: Stage 0 (S1#15) names Nick Fury as the person on May's secret line, but Yes Men only shows May telling an unnamed party 'Coulson knows'; that the line goes to Fury is revealed in Turn, Turn, Turn (S1#17), where stage 1 already sits. Any S1#15 stage on Fury's card spoils the reveal. How should it be handled?
options: Drop stage 0 and let the connection start at S1#17 (stage 1's text already covers May's reports on Coulson)
Keep stage 0 but rewrite it without naming who is on the line (it still appears on Fury's card at S1#15)
owner_calls.evidence: Yes Men: May calls a secured line and says 'Coulson knows.' Turn, Turn, Turn: May tells Coulson the encrypted line was a direct line to Nick Fury, to report GH.325 side effects.

owner_calls.question: Sif says Odin ordered Lorelei brought back, but Yes Men is set after Thor: The Dark World, when Loki is posing as Odin; the MCU wiki says Sif was tasked by Loki masquerading as Odin. Lorelei's card line 'The king who orders Lorelei brought back alive' credits the real Odin. Keep, or reword the card around Odin as the king whose dungeon held her?
options: Keep as is (it is what Sif says on screen)
Reword the card line so it does not claim the real Odin gave the order
owner_calls.evidence: Sif page: 'Sif was tasked by Loki, masquerading as Odin, with capturing her.' Lorelei page trivia notes the same.
